sn45.49:1.2: suriyassa bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ aruṇaggaṃ.
sn45.49:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā.
sn45.49:1.4: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.
sn45.49:1.5: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti, ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti:
sn45.49:1.6: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. sammāsaṅkappaṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāvācaṃ bhāveti -pe- sammākammantaṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāājīvaṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāvāyāmaṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsatiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.49:1.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
